description: BayesFrag provides Python tools for Bayesian fragility estimation from building damage observations. It represents uncertainty in intensity measures and estimates posterior fragility parameters. The repository includes tutorials and accompanies a research paper. These establish usable code and examples, but independent reuse or continuing maintenance beyond the research project was not established. Published by bodlukas (repository owner). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Documentation is accessible through the linked paper or repository; executable access is limited to what that source states. Reuse licence: BSD-3-Clause. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-energyplus.
